data.name: explicit_integration_bundle_ownership
data.description: ServiceContainer now creates and passes the shared integration adapter bundle instead of leaving ownership implicit in multiple runtime seams.

data.formatting: first-pass format scope is limited to manifests and shared quality-config files while lint/typecheck/test enforce active source surfaces

data.description: Desktop Tauri invoke usage is now centralized behind a transport helper and explicit command contract shared by client.ts, bootstrap, and settings save flow.
delivery_gate.py now treats package-level check:local scripts as the local developer-loop anchor while pytest.ini defaults remain coverage-free for the residual Python script surface.
Deprecated web responses now self-identify as compatibility-only via stable headers while preserving validated forwarding and opt-in websocket behavior.

data.name: desktop_api_contract_layer
data.description: Cross-cutting desktop gateway DTO families are now separated from endpoint logic and re-exported through client.ts to preserve the public surface.

data.name: non_skill_knowledge_selection_state
data.description: KnowledgeModal now owns one shared selected-item state for character/location/plot tabs and renders a generic read-only detail card above the tab grid.
KnowledgeModal behavior tests now pin read-only non-skill selection/details and disabled empty-state affordances without depending on backend data loading timing.
StoryBiblePanel now exposes an explicit local-only draft contract in-product and uses graph-backed reads only for characters/locations.
Story Bible local recovery now uses a versioned JSON payload containing only braindump/genres/synopsis/outline/style; graph-backed character/location lists remain outside the payload.
